message: Scope-gate bypass via git C-quoted paths: regex parser missed quoted paths, letting out-of-scope files pass the allowlist gate.
resolution: listPatchChangedFiles derives the write-target list from git apply --numstat -z plus fully C-unquoted rename headers; fail-closed on git errors, malformed records, unterminatable quoting, section-count mismatch. Headless fixtures: unicode path, mixed quoted+unquoted, garbage patch.

message: Scope check threw on legal filenames (spaces), wedging the batch with a stranded proposal.
resolution: Per-file check wrapped: un-normalizable path becomes a normal allowlist violation routed through the repair loop; batch continues, no stranded proposal. Fixture: src/space file.ts.

message: Any gate rejection made goal_met permanently unreachable (any-cycle evaluator block vs current-cycle hook, no re-dispatch).
resolution: Evaluator blocks only on the current cycle's latest fan_out plan; claimed-with-rejected-merge shard yields an honest blocker naming the manual re-drive/flag-off path; superseding plan unblocks. Headless asserts all three.

message: Crash recovery didn't cover kill -9 with a surviving worktree directory (branch locked 'already used by worktree').
resolution: recoverWorktrees scoped to harness prefixes with pruned/reclaimed/skippedForeign classes (PID-marker dead-creator proof; foreign registrations never touched); wired into session_start; mergeShardPlan reuses/resets an existing integration worktree. Headless: surviving-dir kill -9 recovers and merges.

message: git add -A swept test-suite side effects into the shard commit.
resolution: Staging is git add -A -- <patch files> only; smoke 81 + headless assert the commit tree contains only patched paths while the suite writes coverage.txt.

message: Default testCommand 'npm test' unworkable in a fresh worktree (no node_modules).
resolution: defaultRunTests short-circuits npm-family commands when deps are declared but node_modules is absent, failing with a bootstrap-required message; documented in header + config.

message: loadJudgeConfig misparsed separate-fields form for slash model ids, silently falling back to the actor.
resolution: Explicit provider field wins; model id kept verbatim; slash-splitting only without explicit provider; loud log on fallback. Fixture: openrouter + z-ai/glm-5.2.

message: Independence check enforced registry-entry inequality, not model identity.
resolution: canonicalModelKey (namespace fold + zai->z-ai alias) drives the comparison; aliased pair now fails as canonically identical.

message: integrationBranch override escaped harness confinement (existing branch names accepted).
resolution: Overrides must carry the pi-ig/ prefix (refused at load); existing branches must have a harness-authored tip (tip author check) else mergeShardPlan throws. Fixtures both ways.

message: recoverWorktrees unscoped (pruned every stale registration repo-wide) with no production caller.
resolution: Scoped to pi-ig-agent-*/pi-ig-integration-* prefixes with skippedForeign reporting; wired into session_start. Headless asserts a user's vanished ad-hoc worktree survives recovery.

message: capturePatch() returned '' on git error, indistinguishable from 'no changes'.
resolution: capturePatch throws on git error; pool degrades to patch:null; merge layer rejects null at a new capture gate before any proposal.

message: Signed-evidence coverage was partial (trace hashed mid-run then grew; coverage files unsigned).
resolution: Attestation restructured: coverage written before signing; manifest covers final trace.jsonl + coverage files; deliveredBytesVerified:true (87 artifacts).

message: Stale base between shard capture and branch cut; no --3way fallback.
resolution: 2-way-only rationale documented (stale base = HEAD moved mid-run = should reject) in header + config comment.

message: change-set.ts header promised a '--- a/' fallback the code didn't have; line-count nit.
resolution: Parser comment rewritten to match reality.
